    Directing modules #

    Reach₁ X Y: a path X → ⋯ → Y of nonzero non-bijective maps between nonzero indecomposables, of length at least one. M is directing when it is a nonzero indecomposable with no such cycle M → ⋯ → M.

    • Directing.endo: every endomorphism of a directing module is zero or bijective.
    • Directing.split: every short exact sequence 0 → M → E → M → 0 splits (Ext¹(M, M) = 0; Ringel, Tame algebras, 2.4).
